title: Workspaces
description: The workspaces module displays the currently used workspaces in wayland compositor.

placeholders.description: Name of workspace assigned by compositor.
ID of workspace assigned by compositor.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the workspace name and state, the corresponding icon gets selected. See icons.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

sort-by-name.label: Sort by name
sort-by-name.doc: Should workspaces be sorted by name. Workspace names will be sorted numerically when all names are numbers.
sort-by-name.description: Should workspaces be sorted by name. Workspace names will be sorted numerically when all names are numbers.

sort-by-coordinates.label: Sort by coordinates
sort-by-coordinates.doc: Should workspaces be sorted by coordinates. Note that if both sort-by-name and sort-by-coordinates are true sort-by name will be first. If both are false - sort by id will be performed.
sort-by-coordinates.description: Should workspaces be sorted by coordinates. Note that if both sort-by-name and sort-by-coordinates are true sort-by name will be first. If both are false - sort by id will be performed.

sort-by-id.label: Sort by ID
sort-by-id.doc: Should workspaces be sorted by ID. Workspace ID will be sorted numerically when all ID are numbers. Takes precedence over any other sort-by option.
sort-by-id.description: Should workspaces be sorted by ID. Workspace ID will be sorted numerically when all ID are numbers. Takes precedence over any other sort-by option.

sort-by-number.label: Sort by number
sort-by-number.doc: Deprecated alias of sort-by-id. Setting it emits a warning; prefer sort-by-id.
sort-by-number.description: Deprecated alias of sort-by-id. Setting it emits a warning; prefer sort-by-id.

all-outputs.label: All outputs
all-outputs.doc: If set to false workspaces group will be shown only in assigned output. Otherwise, all workspace groups are shown.
all-outputs.description: If set to false workspaces group will be shown only in assigned output. Otherwise, all workspace groups are shown.

active-only.label: Active only
active-only.doc: If set to true only active or urgent workspaces will be shown.
active-only.description: If set to true only active or urgent workspaces will be shown.

disable-scroll.label: Disable scroll
disable-scroll.doc: If set to true, scrolling is disabled for this module.
disable-scroll.description: If set to true, scrolling is disabled for this module.

enable-bar-scroll.label: Enable bar scroll
enable-bar-scroll.doc: If set to true, scrolling anywhere on the bar switches to the previous or next workspace. By default, scrolling only works when the pointer is over the workspaces module
enable-bar-scroll.description: If set to true, scrolling anywhere on the bar switches to the previous or next workspace. By default, scrolling only works when the pointer is over the workspaces module

ignore-hidden.label: Ignore hidden
ignore-hidden.doc: If set to false hidden workspaces will be shown.
ignore-hidden.description: If set to false hidden workspaces will be shown.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: The action to perform on left-click. See CLICK ACTIONS for the possible values.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: The action to perform on middle-click. See CLICK ACTIONS for the possible values.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: The action to perform on right-click. See CLICK ACTIONS for the possible values.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.
